Chapter 55: Your Cousin Is a Very Nice Person

A little after eight in the evening, Li Luo followed Ying Chanxi, strolling out of the classroom on the sixth floor and stretching.

The students on the sports field were still enduring their tough military training, while Li Luo, in his capacity as class monitor, had come for a meeting to hear about the arrangements for the trip to the military camp the day after tomorrow.

"The sunscreen I gave you this morning, did you use it?" Ying Chanxi asked, turning her head as they went downstairs.

"Didn't you watch me put it on?"

"I'm asking about this afternoon." Ying Chanxi shot him a glare. "Did you apply it?"

"...No."

"I'll be here tomorrow at noon to watch you."

"Why are you acting like my mom?" Li Luo said with a speechless look. "It's healthier for guys to have darker skin."

"...You think I enjoy nagging you?" Ying Chanxi huffed, her steps down the stairs becoming a bit heavier. "Fine, don't use it if you don't want to!"

Bantering and bickering, the two made their way to the entrance of the sports field, then parted ways, each heading toward their own class formation.

There were still twenty minutes left until military training ended, and the entire sports field had already entered a rest period.

When Li Luo returned to his group, everyone was sitting on the ground. Only Lin Yuan was standing at the front, singing "A Little Sweet."

"A talent show?" Li Luo plopped down next to Yan Zhusheng and asked curiously, turning his head.

"Mhm." Yan Zhusheng nodded, then commented with a serious expression, "That last line, he sang two notes wrong, and he strained his voice on the high note."

"...You don't have to be so harsh with our classmates." Li Luo looked speechless, recalling the days in his past life when he was "military-trained" by Yan Zhusheng while learning guitar and singing.

Back then, aside from practicing piano and singing, eating, and sleeping, Yan Zhusheng had nothing else to do.

Most of her free time was spent either listening to music or reading.

Later, one more thing was added to her routine: teaching Li Luo to play the guitar.

It didn't start because Li Luo actually wanted to learn. It was simply because he had accepted a role in a short drama where the main character had to play the guitar. Li Luo just happened to need to learn about it, so he asked Yan Zhusheng.

One thing led to another, and he inexplicably started learning.

Yan Zhusheng was quite serious in this regard. Li Luo's questions were very basic, but Yan Zhusheng always explained them in great depth.

It got to the point where he wrote too much professional knowledge into the script, which was ultimately cut by the production team, and he didn't earn a single cent.

"Aren't you going to go up and sing?" Li Luo smiled and asked, turning his head as he recalled these amusing memories.

"How do you know I can sing?" Yan Zhusheng asked in return.

"Have you forgotten?" Li Luo reminded her. "During your self-introduction, you said you liked music and running."

"But I didn't say I like singing, did I?" Yan Zhusheng tilted her head and pressed, very particular about these small details.

Faced with this familiar feeling, Li Luo's mouth could only twitch. "...I probably just took one look at you and thought you must have a beautiful singing voice."

"Then I'll go sing," Yan Zhusheng said. "You can have a listen."

"Alright."

Just as they finished talking, Lin Yuan also finished singing "A Little Sweet." As he walked back to the group, he secretly glanced at Hua Xiuxiu to see her reaction, then sat on the ground with a slightly red face.

At that moment, Yan Zhusheng stood up, about to walk forward, when a long whistle suddenly blew from the center of the sports field, announcing the end of tonight's military training.

"Too bad, looks like we'll have to wait until tomorrow to hear you." Li Luo smiled, stood up, and patted his butt. After Instructor Zhang announced their dismissal, he started walking toward the classroom. "But I have a guitar at home. I can bring it tomorrow. I can play accompaniment for you?"

Yan Zhusheng, who hadn't been able to sing, was originally frowning with a bit of displeasure. But when she heard Li Luo's words, her brow suddenly smoothed out. "Okay, you know how to play the guitar too?"

"Just a tiny little bit." Li Luo pinched his thumb and index finger together, making a gesture.

In front of Yan Zhusheng, Li Luo really only dared to claim he knew a tiny little bit. After all, his guitar skills were personally taught to him by the Yan Zhusheng of his past life.

According to what Yan Zhusheng had said back then, his current level was barely at the entry-level. Fooling people who didn't know any better was no problem.

The two returned to the classroom. Li Luo packed his schoolbag at his desk, preparing to go home.

The other boarding students still had to attend an evening self-study session in the classroom and could only leave after it ended.

Just then, Yan Zhusheng turned her head to look at Li Luo and suddenly said, "Can I ask you for a favor?"

"Hmm? What's wrong?"

"I've run out of sunscreen." Yan Zhusheng took out a bottle of sunscreen and shook it in her hand. It was already empty. "Could you help me buy a bottle?"

"Oh, this." Li Luo raised his eyebrows, subconsciously opening his schoolbag and taking out a bottle of sunscreen. He held it out toward Yan Zhusheng. "I have a bottle here, you can just... uh... wait."

As he was speaking, Li Luo caught sight of Ying Chanxi at the back door. He immediately pulled the sunscreen back and stuffed it into his schoolbag.

He must have lost his mind, daring to give away the sunscreen Ying Chanxi had given him.

If Ying Chanxi found out, he'd probably get his head bashed in.

At this thought, Li Luo's mouth twitched, and he quickly changed his words, "I'll help you buy a bottle on my way home. I'll give it to you tomorrow."

"Oh." Yan Zhusheng looked at the sunscreen Li Luo had put away but didn't ask any further questions. She simply nodded and said, "Thank you."

Li Luo waved his hand and walked out of the classroom with his schoolbag on.

Ying Chanxi, who was outside the door, asked suspiciously, "What were you two talking about?"

"Guess."

"Guess my foot!" Ying Chanxi huffed and turned toward the stairs. "Fine, don't tell me."

The two of them walked out of the school together. As they neared the entrance to their residential community, Li Luo finally said, "My deskmate ran out of sunscreen and asked me to help her buy a new bottle."

"Is that what you were talking about in the classroom just now?" Ying Chanxi asked.

"Yeah."

"Don't you have a bottle?" Ying Chanxi's eyes darted around as she secretly peeked at him out of the corner of her eye, asking probingly.

Hearing Ying Chanxi ask this, Li Luo immediately adopted a serious expression and said, "This is a gift from you. How could I give it to someone else?"

"Hmph, at least you have some conscience." The corners of Ying Chanxi's mouth couldn't help but curve up, and her steps became a little lighter. She walked toward the supermarket at the community entrance. "Let's go, we'll buy a bottle for your deskmate. You don't know which brand is good, so I'll help her pick."

...

Early the next morning, Li Luo arrived at the Class Eight classroom carrying a guitar case, while Ying Chanxi brought an extra bottle of new sunscreen.

Seeing Yan Zhusheng at her seat, Ying Chanxi walked over warmly, took out the carefully selected sunscreen from last night, and handed it to her.

"Li Luo told me you ran out of sunscreen, so I bought a bottle for you," Ying Chanxi said. "This one is more moisturizing. You just need to apply it once in the morning and once at noon."

"Oh, thank you." Yan Zhusheng took the sunscreen and then asked, "How much was it?"

"It wasn't much, just consider it a gift." Ying Chanxi waved her hand. "Just use it. I'm leaving now."

After speaking, Ying Chanxi turned and left stylishly under the gazes of the Class Eight students.

Holding the sunscreen, Yan Zhusheng looked up at Li Luo beside her. "Should I give the money to you?"

"No need, it's not like I paid for it." Li Luo shook his head. "At most, you can find a chance to treat her to a meal."

"Oh." Yan Zhusheng nodded and then said, "Your cousin is a very nice person."
